# Vendored from the iPad app

These files are copied, unmodified, from the repository of Slowpage for iPadOS (`inkpad-ipados`, by the same author). That repository is private, so this repository carries everything the Android build takes from it, and builds without it.

Source repository: `inkpad-ipados` (private; GitHub `50hoursaweek/inkpad-ipados`)
Source commit: `873d4f4c74ea22a52658494f2697e86c3a146ddf`
Paths are the same as in the source repository. No git history was copied.

## What is here, and its licence
| Path | What | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `HushHourCore/Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `src/` | `hushhour-ipad`: the UniFFI bridge over `hushhour-core`, document rules, spotlight layer, audio mixer. `scripts/build-rust.sh` builds it for Android and the Mac. | MIT (`LICENSE-Slowpage.txt`) |
| `HushHourCore/assets/sounds/` | The two typing-sound sets, embedded in the library at build time; `README.md` gives their origin | CC0 1.0 (unicaegames, OpenGameArt) |
| `HushHour/HushHour/Resources/Music/*.ogg` | The six music loops | Music loops generated with Google Lyria 3 (AI, SynthID watermark). Dedicated to the public domain under CC0, to the extent any rights exist. |
| `HushHour/HushHour/Resources/Fonts/` | IBM Plex Mono, IBM Plex Sans, Literata, Lato Regular, unmodified, with their licences and `README.md` (provenance and checksums) | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `HushHour/HushHour/Resources/Licences/` | The licence texts shown under About → Credits and licences: Slowpage, hushhour-core, sounds, MPL 2.0, and `LICENSES-rust.txt` (every Rust crate linked into the core) | The texts themselves |
| `HushHour/HushHour/Resources/Assets.xcassets/Icon.imageset/Icon-*.png` | The icon shown in About | MIT, with the app |
| `HushHour/HushHour/Resources/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon-light-1024.png` | The app icon art; `build-rust.sh` scales it to the launcher icons | MIT, with the app |

Not copied, because only the iPad uses them:
- the Swift app and the Xcode project;
- App Store metadata;
- `build-xcframework.sh`, `licenses.sh` and the C header `HushHourMixer.h`;
- the other icon variants;
- the iPad's `NOTICE.md`;
- the iPad's audit files.

The music credit above is the Android wording, agreed by the author on 2026-11-01. The iPad app's and the Linux app's own credits still read "generated by the author with Google Lyria 3, CC0 1.0" until they are next updated. The vendored files themselves are unchanged; none of them carries that credit.

`hushhour-core` itself is not vendored. Cargo fetches it from the public HushHour repository (https://github.com/50hoursaweek/hushhour, tag `v0.4.2`, commit `88c40d19cd60a12a5eb1d1e12a98776ac42315ff`), as `Cargo.lock` pins it.

## Re-sync (maintainer only; never part of a normal build)
With a local checkout of `inkpad-ipados`, which is only read:
```
scripts/sync-vendored-core.sh <commit> [path-to-inkpad-ipados]
```
Then:
1. Update "Source commit" above and the checksums below.
2. Review the diff.
3. Rebuild (`scripts/build-rust.sh`).
4. Update `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` if a crate or asset changed.
